description: This file defines the CheckoutViewModel class for managing the checkout process in an Android app. It handles form state, validation, simulated payment processing, and order creation, coordinating between UI and repositories.

classes.name: CheckoutViewModel
classes.description: The main ViewModel class coordinating the checkout process, managing form data, validation, payment simulation, and order creation via repositories.

classes.name: FormState
classes.description: Data class holding the form fields required for checkout, such as customer info, address, payment choice, etc.

classes.name: FieldErrors
classes.description: Data class representing validation error messages for each form field.

classes.name: PaymentState
classes.description: Sealed class representing different payment statuses/status transitions: idle, processing, success, decline.

classes.name: SubmitState
classes.description: Sealed class representing the state of the order submission process, including idle, loading, success, and error states.

methods.name: prefillEmailIfAvailable
methods.description: Prefills the email in the form if an active email exists in the cart repository.

methods.name: applyLastPaymentMethodIfAvailable
methods.description: Loads and applies the last used payment method from preferences if available.

methods.name: updateCustomerName
methods.description: Updates the customer name in the form state.

methods.name: updateEmail
methods.description: Updates the email field in the form state.

methods.name: updateAddressLine1
methods.description: Updates the address line 1 in the form state.

methods.name: updateCity
methods.description: Updates the city in the form state.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the state/region in the form state.

methods.name: updatePostalCode
methods.description: Updates the postal code in the form state.

methods.name: updateCountry
methods.description: Updates the country in the form state.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates the optional note field.

methods.name: setMockPaymentSuccess
methods.description: Enables or disables the simulated successful payment response.

methods.name: updatePaymentMethod
methods.description: Sets the selected payment method and optionally persists it as last used.

methods.name: updateCouponInput
methods.description: Updates the user's input for coupon code.

methods.name: applyCouponFromCheckout
methods.description: Applies the current coupon input to the cart repository.

methods.name: removeCoupon
methods.description: Removes the applied coupon.

methods.name: addSavedCoupon
methods.description: Adds a coupon code to the list of saved coupons.

methods.name: removeSavedCoupon
methods.description: Removes a coupon code from the saved list.

methods.name: clearSavedCoupons
methods.description: Clears all saved coupons.

methods.name: isCouponSaved
methods.description: Checks if a coupon code is in the saved list.

methods.name: clearSubmitError
methods.description: Resets the submission error state.

methods.name: placeOrder
methods.description: Validates the form, performs a simulated payment, then creates an order and clears the cart upon success.

methods.name: initialFormState
methods.description: Creates an initial form state, preferring last used payment method.

methods.name: setForm
methods.description: Updates the form state and resets field errors.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form fields, returning any errors.

methods.name: runPaymentSimulation
methods.description: Simulates a payment process with delay, handles approval/decline based on settings.

methods.name: mapError
methods.description: Maps caught exceptions to user-readable error states.
